name: Dumbbell Contralateral Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a single dumbbell at your side in one hand.
Step forward with the leg opposite the dumbbell and bend both knees until your rear knee nears the floor.
Drive through your front foot to return to standing while keeping your torso upright.
Complete the working side, then switch hands and lead legs to repeat.
tips: Keep your shoulders level and core braced despite the uneven load.
Track your front knee over your toes and keep your front heel planted.
